features.title: Interactive Panel
features.what: Presents menus, controls and reports.
features.when: Operate diagnostics from Flipper controls or a terminal.
features.value: A consistent interface across tools.
features.limits: Candidate not hardware-tested.

features.title: Task management
features.what: Streams output and manages owned task cancellation.
features.when: Check progress, stop or review a task.
features.value: Visible progress and controlled tool handover.
features.limits: Cleanup paths need final regression tests.

features.title: Basic Wi-Fi scan
features.what: Discovers APs, signal, channels and names; creates targets.
features.when: Find nearby APs for investigation.
features.value: Discovery feeds focused follow-up actions.
features.limits: Grouping can be estimated; names may be absent.

features.title: Advanced Wi-Fi scan
features.what: Collects passive AP/client metadata, directional retries and activity.
features.when: Investigate reception and captured delivery evidence.
features.value: Evidence includes sample counts, ages and limits.
features.limits: Hopping misses frames; retries are not end-to-end loss.

features.title: Wi-Fi waterfall
features.what: Shows AP packet RSSI by channel and over time.
features.when: Walk around and compare signal observations.
features.value: Readable live channel history.
features.limits: Not RF spectrum; 6 GHz needs tested hardware.

features.title: Connected client health
features.what: Tests a connected external client, reachability and throughput.
features.when: Separate local link symptoms from upstream limits.
features.value: Combines measured checks and evidence coverage.
features.limits: Sends traffic; requires a connected managed test adapter.

features.title: Wi-Fi target tracking
features.what: Tracks selected APs, observed clients and probes.
features.when: Focus on a discovered target.
features.value: Continuous signal and freshness feedback.
features.limits: Signal trend is not distance or guaranteed direction.

features.title: Ethernet link and switch
features.what: Shows link, counters and observed LLDP/CDP/VLAN/LACP evidence.
features.when: Identify a connected switch port and link symptoms.
features.value: Combines port identity with live link status.
features.limits: Some fields require driver support or switch announcements.

features.title: Direct Ethernet
features.what: Provides passive, temporary static and diagnostic DHCP modes.
features.when: Inspect directly connected equipment.
features.value: Field diagnostics without its normal network.
features.limits: Active modes temporarily configure eth0; dual-adapter use is not implemented.

features.title: Host discovery and profiles
features.what: Discovers responding hosts and profiles common services.
features.when: Identify reachable equipment and service clues.
features.value: Subnet overview leads to focused host targets.
features.limits: Active probes; empty output can be inconclusive.

features.title: Observed topology
features.what: Builds evidence-labelled neighbour and wireless relationships.
features.when: Understand observed connections.
features.value: Avoids inventing wired links from names or addresses.
features.limits: Not a complete switch topology collector.

features.title: Network monitor
features.what: Preserves the inherited monitoring/report workflow.
features.when: Observe traffic over an interval.
features.value: A fallback alongside focused capture tools.
features.limits: Candidate stop/restore behaviour needs testing.

features.title: Packet capture
features.what: Captures general, probe, station, EAPOL, deauthentication or raw observations.
features.when: Collect protocol evidence for analysis.
features.value: Different views of captured traffic.
features.limits: Observation is not transmission; broken legacy modes are quarantined.

features.title: Saved-capture analysis
features.what: Analyses DNS, DHCP, TCP retransmission, ARP and broadcast evidence.
features.when: Review an incident after capturing it.
features.value: Turns packets into bounded diagnostic findings.
features.limits: Missing or encrypted traffic can prevent interpretation.

features.title: Route and connectivity
features.what: Inspects addresses, routes and reachability.
features.when: Check which path is used.
features.value: Helps separate routing faults from radio symptoms.
features.limits: Some checks send probes; VPN setup is deferred.

features.title: iperf tools
features.what: Provides server controls and client/interface helpers.
features.when: Measure throughput against a controlled peer.
features.value: Local testing independent of Internet speed servers.
features.limits: Requires a peer; server start opens a listening service.

features.title: Security scan
features.what: Collects service findings, CVE applicability and vendor evidence.
features.when: Prioritise configuration/vendor review.
features.value: Separates possible, observed and vendor-supported findings.
features.limits: Active checks; no registered CVE-specific execution validators.

features.title: Device Watch
features.what: Collects BLE advertisements and Wi-Fi observations with confidence labels.
features.when: Discover relevant nearby advertised devices.
features.value: Selected targets avoid targeting all observations.
features.limits: Identities can be spoofed; foreground targets are capped.

features.title: BLE target tracking
features.what: Tracks an advertised MAC with signal/freshness states.
features.when: Follow an eligible discovered BLE device.
features.value: Continuous fresh/stale/searching feedback.
features.limits: Randomised MACs and quiet advertising affect continuity.

features.title: Device history
features.what: Retains bounded appearance and change events.
features.when: Compare scans across visits.
features.value: Adds context beyond a single run.
features.limits: Not seen does not prove departure.

features.title: Site survey reports
features.what: Records location-tagged readings and exports floor-plan HTML.
features.when: Compare measurements at labelled positions.
features.value: Portable offline measured-point reporting.
features.limits: No interpolated coverage prediction.

features.title: Wi-Fi recovery
features.what: Reports adapter state and restores permitted development radios.
features.when: Recover after interrupted capture.
features.value: Controlled recovery with built-in radio protection.
features.limits: Needs hardware registration; refuses conflicting owners.

features.title: Shared serial console
features.what: Provides one serial owner shared by local/remote terminal clients.
features.when: Reach physical console equipment and collaborate.
features.value: Portable console-server workflow.
features.limits: Account/privilege activation is gated; no remote access is enabled.

features.title: Remote report viewing
features.what: Retains an independent restricted scan-report browser.
features.when: Let a remote colleague inspect the local scan.
features.value: Two-person troubleshooting without shared navigation.
features.limits: Candidate includes optional SMTP and local credential fallback; account/policy activation remains gated.

features.title: Display and startup
features.what: Renders the local LCD and manages display handover.
features.when: Use the toolkit without a desktop.
features.value: Consistent portable presentation and terminal fallback.
features.limits: Platform/display defaults and asset rights need review.

features.title: Game controls
features.what: Preserves ROM discovery and bhtui control integration.
features.when: Use the existing game workflow when configured.
features.value: Secondary use without a core dependency.
features.limits: No ROMs or emulator binary bundled; not certified.

features.title: Uplink Auto-Connect
features.what: Connects to saved uplink profiles according to user preferences.
features.when: Reconnect across known networks.
features.value: Convenient management connectivity.
features.limits: Deferred by request; personal watcher not packaged.

features.title: Email setup
features.what: Guides SMTP setup and shares one sender across access notifications.
features.when: Configure optional credential delivery from SSH or serial.
features.value: Access works without email; failure retains local details.
features.limits: Requires TLS SMTP/app credentials; no test email sent by setup.

features.title: VPN setup
features.what: Imports a self-contained OpenVPN profile and offers explicit On/Off.
features.when: Use your chosen VPN provider when configured.
features.value: No provider lock-in and no connection before configuration.
features.limits: Conservative import rejects unsupported profile directives; account/service activation gated.

features.title: Recovery hotspot
features.what: Configures a phone/router hotspot name and password for management override.
features.when: Regain control through a known reachable hotspot.
features.value: Provides an owner-configured recovery path without a preconfigured hotspot.
features.limits: Opt-in; can switch wlan0. WPA personal hotspot only; no enterprise/captive-portal setup.

features.title: Vehicle Diagnostics
features.what: Reads standard engine/emissions codes, readiness, freeze frames and live values; records and exports evidence with an offline DTC library.
features.when: Investigate check-engine conditions, compare scans and capture changing readings without an internet connection.
features.value: Local display, console and authenticated browser share one cancellable adapter owner and source-aware explanations.
features.limits: Vehicle and adapter support varies. Standard engine/emissions only. USB, Classic SPP and vehicle decoding await physical adapter/vehicle testing. Community definitions remain unverified; package activation remains gated.

features.title: System and hardware status
features.what: Shows temperature, memory, storage, uptime, interfaces and hardware/service status.
features.when: Check field readiness and resource pressure.
features.value: Quickly separates a resource or link problem from a diagnostic result.
features.limits: Readings describe the local board; platform sensors may be absent.

features.title: USB device inventory
features.what: Enumerates connected USB hardware and available adapters.
features.when: Identify connected field peripherals.
features.value: Makes adapter availability visible before starting a workflow.
features.limits: USB product labels do not establish chipset/driver capabilities.

features.title: Generated target workflows
features.what: Groups discovered hosts, APs, BLE devices and security findings into follow-up actions.
features.when: Move from discovery to a focused investigation without retyping identifiers.
features.value: Connects discovery, evidence and tracking in one interface.
features.limits: Targets can be stale; identity and severity retain their original uncertainty.

features.title: Protected uplink radio
features.what: Verifies registered radio identity and bus before allowing USB capture/reset workflows.
features.when: Keep the native management uplink separate from development radios.
features.value: Reduces accidental loss of management access during radio work.
features.limits: Requires real device registration; USB naming/order and firmware still need device-specific testing.

features.title: Flipper control and power
features.what: The board accepts menu controls from a compatible separately supplied Flipper app.
features.when: Operate the board while walking without attaching a laptop.
features.value: Supports local field operation when a compatible companion is available.
features.limits: No companion app or FAP is distributed in this release. Use PC serial or SSH.

features.title: Locally generated documentation
features.what: Generates feature and process guides from source/catalog hashes.
features.when: Read purpose, use cases, value and limits without internet.
features.value: Documentation travels with the tools and can be reviewed alongside the implementation.
features.limits: The process map is static evidence, not proof of complete runtime dependency closure.

features.title: OBD traffic and keyboard access
features.menu: Vehicle Diagnostics > Remote access & data flow
features.what: Displays actual ELM serial TX/RX and queues read-only typed requests through the shared owner.
features.when: Understand adapter responses or drive diagnostics from a PC keyboard.
features.value: Links decoded readings to real adapter traffic without a second serial reader.
features.limits: Not a passive raw CAN monitor. Optional conveh provisioning is opt-in; physical adapter/vehicle testing pending.

features.title: PC Recovery
features.what: Private development recovery workflows are not packaged for activation.
features.when: Future integration of owner-configured recovery tools.
features.value: Keeps personal recovery media and setup out of the public source package.
features.limits: Deferred; not an active public-release feature.
